problems.explain: Each corner sits between two sides, so pair the corners by the marks on their sides. A is between the sides with 3 ticks and 1 tick, and so is R; B is between the sides with 3 ticks and 2 ticks, and so is P; C is between the sides with 2 ticks and 1 tick, and so is Q. So A, B, C pair with R, P, Q, written in that order. (△ABC ≅ △PQR, in alphabetical order, would pair A with P, which the marks do not.) So △ABC ≅ △RPQ.
